explanation: This component is 0 everywhere except at the D1 step after a trial where the agent chose a2, got a rare transition to S1, and was rewarded; there it is usually 9-10, dropping to about 4-5 if the trial before that was also a rewarded rare a2-to-S1 trial or the agent has drifted toward S1. It stays 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at D1 after any common trial, after a rewarded a1-to-S1 trial (0-1 at most), or after an unrewarded trial.
